input: What are the top 5 most frequently purchased products in our bakery?
output: SELECT g.Id, g.Food, g.Flavor, COUNT(*) AS PurchaseCount FROM items i JOIN goods g ON i.Item = g.Id GROUP BY g.Id, g.Food, g.Flavor ORDER BY PurchaseCount DESC LIMIT 5;

input: Which customers spent the most in total at our bakery during October 2007?
output: SELECT c.Id, c.FirstName, c.LastName, SUM(g.Price) AS TotalSpent FROM customers c JOIN receipts r ON c.Id = r.CustomerId JOIN items i ON r.ReceiptNumber = i.Receipt JOIN goods g ON i.Item = g.Id GROUP BY c.Id, c.FirstName, c.LastName ORDER BY TotalSpent DESC LIMIT 10;

input: What is the average transaction value for each day of the week?
output: SELECT CASE CAST(SUBSTR(r.Date, 2, 2) AS INTEGER) % 7 WHEN 1 THEN 'Monday' WHEN 2 THEN 'Tuesday' WHEN 3 THEN 'Wednesday' WHEN 4 THEN 'Thursday' WHEN 5 THEN 'Friday' WHEN 6 THEN 'Saturday' ELSE 'Sunday' END AS DayOfWeek, AVG(subquery.ReceiptTotal) AS AverageTransactionValue FROM receipts r JOIN (SELECT i.Receipt, SUM(g.Price) AS ReceiptTotal FROM items i JOIN goods g ON i.Item = g.Id GROUP BY i.Receipt) subquery ON r.ReceiptNumber = subquery.Receipt GROUP BY DayOfWeek ORDER BY CASE DayOfWeek WHEN 'Monday' THEN 1 WHEN 'Tuesday' THEN 2 WHEN 'Wednesday' THEN 3 WHEN 'Thursday' THEN 4 WHEN 'Friday' THEN 5 WHEN 'Saturday' THEN 6 WHEN 'Sunday' THEN 7 END;

input: What are the three most popular product categories based on total sales?
output: SELECT g.Food AS Category, COUNT(*) AS TotalSales FROM items i JOIN goods g ON i.Item = g.Id GROUP BY g.Food ORDER BY TotalSales DESC LIMIT 3;

input: Which products generated the most revenue in October 2007?
output: SELECT g.Id, g.Food, g.Flavor, SUM(g.Price) AS TotalRevenue FROM items i JOIN goods g ON i.Item = g.Id GROUP BY g.Id, g.Food, g.Flavor ORDER BY TotalRevenue DESC LIMIT 10;

input: Who are our top 10 customers by number of visits?
output: SELECT c.Id, c.FirstName, c.LastName, COUNT(DISTINCT r.ReceiptNumber) AS NumberOfVisits FROM customers c JOIN receipts r ON c.Id = r.CustomerId GROUP BY c.Id, c.FirstName, c.LastName ORDER BY NumberOfVisits DESC LIMIT 10;

input: What is the daily revenue trend throughout October 2007?
output: SELECT SUBSTR(r.Date, 2, LENGTH(r.Date) - 2) AS SaleDate, SUM(g.Price) AS DailyRevenue FROM receipts r JOIN items i ON r.ReceiptNumber = i.Receipt JOIN goods g ON i.Item = g.Id GROUP BY SaleDate ORDER BY SaleDate;

input: Which product flavors appear across multiple product categories?
output: SELECT g.Flavor, COUNT(DISTINCT g.Food) AS CategoryCount, GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT g.Food) AS Categories FROM goods g GROUP BY g.Flavor HAVING CategoryCount > 1 ORDER BY CategoryCount DESC;

input: What is the average number of items purchased per transaction?
output: SELECT AVG(ItemCount) AS AverageItemsPerTransaction FROM (SELECT i.Receipt, COUNT(*) AS ItemCount FROM items i GROUP BY i.Receipt);

input: Which products are most commonly purchased together?
output: SELECT g1.Food || ' - ' || g1.Flavor AS Product1, g2.Food || ' - ' || g2.Flavor AS Product2, COUNT(*) AS PairCount FROM items i1 JOIN items i2 ON i1.Receipt = i2.Receipt AND i1.Item < i2.Item JOIN goods g1 ON i1.Item = g1.Id JOIN goods g2 ON i2.Item = g2.Id GROUP BY Product1, Product2 ORDER BY PairCount DESC LIMIT 10;

input: What day of the week has the highest number of transactions?
output: SELECT CASE CAST(SUBSTR(r.Date, 2, 2) AS INTEGER) % 7 WHEN 1 THEN 'Monday' WHEN 2 THEN 'Tuesday' WHEN 3 THEN 'Wednesday' WHEN 4 THEN 'Thursday' WHEN 5 THEN 'Friday' WHEN 6 THEN 'Saturday' ELSE 'Sunday' END AS DayOfWeek, COUNT(DISTINCT r.ReceiptNumber) AS TransactionCount FROM receipts r GROUP BY DayOfWeek ORDER BY TransactionCount DESC LIMIT 1;

input: Which customers have purchased at least one item from each product category?
output: WITH CustomerCategories AS (SELECT DISTINCT r.CustomerId, g.Food AS Category FROM receipts r JOIN items i ON r.ReceiptNumber = i.Receipt JOIN goods g ON i.Item = g.Id), CategoryCount AS (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT Food) AS TotalCategories FROM goods) SELECT c.Id, c.FirstName || ' ' || c.LastName AS CustomerName, COUNT(DISTINCT cc.Category) AS CategoriesPurchased FROM customers c JOIN CustomerCategories cc ON c.Id = cc.CustomerId CROSS JOIN CategoryCount cat GROUP BY c.Id, CustomerName HAVING CategoriesPurchased = cat.TotalCategories ORDER BY c.Id;

input: What is the revenue distribution by product category?
output: SELECT g.Food AS Category, SUM(g.Price) AS TotalRevenue, ROUND(SUM(g.Price) * 100.0 / (SELECT SUM(Price) FROM goods JOIN items ON goods.Id = items.Item), 2) AS PercentOfTotalRevenue FROM items i JOIN goods g ON i.Item = g.Id GROUP BY g.Food ORDER BY TotalRevenue DESC;

input: Which customers made multiple visits to our bakery in October 2007?
output: SELECT c.Id, c.FirstName, c.LastName, COUNT(DISTINCT r.ReceiptNumber) AS VisitCount FROM customers c JOIN receipts r ON c.Id = r.CustomerId GROUP BY c.Id, c.FirstName, c.LastName HAVING VisitCount > 1 ORDER BY VisitCount DESC LIMIT 10;

input: Which products have the highest price to sales ratio?
output: SELECT g.Id, g.Food, g.Flavor, g.Price, COUNT(*) AS SalesCount, ROUND(g.Price / COUNT(*), 2) AS PriceToSalesRatio FROM items i JOIN goods g ON i.Item = g.Id GROUP BY g.Id, g.Food, g.Flavor, g.Price ORDER BY PriceToSalesRatio DESC LIMIT 10;

input: What is the average spending per visit for each customer?
output: SELECT c.Id, c.FirstName, c.LastName, COUNT(DISTINCT r.ReceiptNumber) AS VisitCount, SUM(g.Price) AS TotalSpent, ROUND(SUM(g.Price) / COUNT(DISTINCT r.ReceiptNumber), 2) AS AverageSpendPerVisit FROM customers c JOIN receipts r ON c.Id = r.CustomerId JOIN items i ON r.ReceiptNumber = i.Receipt JOIN goods g ON i.Item = g.Id GROUP BY c.Id, c.FirstName, c.LastName ORDER BY AverageSpendPerVisit DESC;

input: How do weekday sales compare to weekend sales in terms of volume and revenue?
output: SELECT CASE WHEN CAST(SUBSTR(r.Date, 2, 2) AS INTEGER) % 7 IN (0, 6) THEN 'Weekend' ELSE 'Weekday' END AS DayType, COUNT(DISTINCT r.ReceiptNumber) AS TransactionCount, SUM(g.Price) AS TotalRevenue, COUNT(*) AS ItemsSold, ROUND(SUM(g.Price) / COUNT(DISTINCT r.ReceiptNumber), 2) AS AverageTransactionValue FROM receipts r JOIN items i ON r.ReceiptNumber = i.Receipt JOIN goods g ON i.Item = g.Id GROUP BY DayType;

input: Which flavor is the most popular across all product categories?
output: SELECT g.Flavor, COUNT(*) AS PurchaseCount FROM items i JOIN goods g ON i.Item = g.Id GROUP BY g.Flavor ORDER BY PurchaseCount DESC LIMIT 1;

input: What time of the month (early, mid, late) has the highest sales?
output: SELECT CASE WHEN CAST(SUBSTR(r.Date, 2, 2) AS INTEGER) <= 10 THEN 'Early October' WHEN CAST(SUBSTR(r.Date, 2, 2) AS INTEGER) <= 20 THEN 'Mid October' ELSE 'Late October' END AS TimePeriod, COUNT(*) AS ItemsSold, SUM(g.Price) AS TotalRevenue FROM receipts r JOIN items i ON r.ReceiptNumber = i.Receipt JOIN goods g ON i.Item = g.Id GROUP BY TimePeriod ORDER BY TotalRevenue DESC;

input: Which customers purchase the most varied products?
output: SELECT c.Id, c.FirstName, c.LastName, COUNT(DISTINCT g.Id) AS UniqueProducts, COUNT(DISTINCT g.Food) AS UniqueCategories, COUNT(DISTINCT g.Flavor) AS UniqueFlavors FROM customers c JOIN receipts r ON c.Id = r.CustomerId JOIN items i ON r.ReceiptNumber = i.Receipt JOIN goods g ON i.Item = g.Id GROUP BY c.Id, c.FirstName, c.LastName ORDER BY UniqueProducts DESC, UniqueCategories DESC, UniqueFlavors DESC LIMIT 10;
